review.description: Adopt same-run follow-up, active-turn steering and deliberate interruption in S1-S3.
review.implementation: Reviewed Message routing between idle start and expected-turn steer, plus Interrupt and provider notification state updates. Disconnected sessions require explicit resume.
review.tests: Assembled UI sends follow-up on the retained run; lifecycle fixture rejects stale steering and accepts the matching turn. Direct interruption is an opt-in real lifecycle observation and is explicitly a missing default fixture assertion.
